en.title: Hacker News: Meta Security Researcher's AI Agent Accidentally Deleted Her Emails
en.hook: A stark reminder of AI agent safety risks after an autonomous agent mistakenly wiped real user data.
key_takeaways: Unintended side effects and critical risks of autonomous AI agents
Highlighting the urgent need for robust permission controls and guardrails
Crucial lessons for safely testing and deploying agents in production

key_takeaways: 自主 AI 代理带来的意外副作用与严重风险
凸显了对 LLM 代理进行严格权限控制与安全防护的急迫性
在真实环境中测试和部署代理时的重要安全教训
